content.short: Polkadot is a sharded protocol that enables blockchain networks to operate together seamlessly.
content.description: Polkadot combines a native token with a decentralized protocol that can be bought and sold on major exchanges. The Polkadot protocol enables unrelated blockchains to securely communicate with one another, allowing value or data to flow between ecosystems such as Ethereum and Bitcoin without the need for an intermediary. It is designed for speed and scalability through multiple parallel blockchains that share processing tasks and help relieve network load.
content.meta: Polkadot is a sharded protocol enabling blockchain networks to operate together seamlessly. Discover Polkadot and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
